name: Aloo Tamatar Curry
instructions: Cook until the potatoes are soft.

name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Beat the eggs in a bowl.
Mix the vegetables with the eggs.
Cook thoroughly in a heated pan.

name: Potato Sandwich
instructions: Mix with chopped onions and salt.

name: Tomato Soup
instructions: Cook onions and garlic in a pan.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice and allow it to cool.
Cook garlic and vegetables in a pan.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce.
Mix and cook until thoroughly hot.

name: Banana Pancakes
instructions: Mix with egg, milk and flour.
Cook small portions in a buttered pan.

name: Chicken Curry
instructions: Heat oil and cook chopped onions.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Cook until the chicken is thoroughly cooked.

name: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Cut the chicken and vegetables into small pieces.
Add soy sauce and stir well.
Cook until the vegetables are tender.

name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Season the chicken with paprika and lime.
Cook the chicken thoroughly in a pan.

name: Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta according to its package instructions.
Cook the chicken thoroughly in olive oil.
Add tomatoes and cook into a sauce.
Mix in the pasta and chicken.

name: Beef Stew
instructions: Cut the beef and vegetables into pieces.
Cook onions and garlic in a pot.
Add beef and brown the outside.
Simmer until the beef is tender and thoroughly cooked.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Cook the beef with cumin until thoroughly cooked.
Fill tortillas with beef and vegetables.

name: Lamb Curry
instructions: Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Cook until the lamb is tender and thoroughly cooked.

name: Lamb Kebabs
instructions: Mix with finely chopped onion and garlic.
Add cumin, paprika, salt and pepper.

name: Fish Curry
instructions: Cook onions, ginger and garlic in oil.
Simmer until the fish is thoroughly cooked.

name: Lemon Garlic Fish
instructions: Mix melted butter, garlic and lemon juice.
Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Cook the fish with the garlic mixture.
Make sure the fish is thoroughly cooked before serving.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Stir and cook until the vegetables are tender.

name: Spinach Potato Curry
instructions: Wash and chop spinach and potatoes.
Cook onions and garlic in oil.
Add potatoes and cook until tender.
Add spinach and cook until soft.

name: Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
Cook garlic and mushrooms in butter.
Mix in the pasta and serve.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: Chop the onion, pepper and tomatoes.
Cook onion, garlic and pepper in olive oil.
Add eggs and cook until they are fully set.
